title: Repair Rust UI Test Crates After API Removals
description: Repair the Rust UI test crates under 🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🖱️ui broken by API removals and the arena-registration refactor: non-compiling crates (wgpu-engine-laws, engine-scene-laws, layout-laws, raster, locale, text-splice-native), 9 failing wgpu-laws (panic-safe arena scope), 5 stale contract-conformance fixtures (with TS twin), clipboard ingress admission laws, events/mounted-layout settling, and sweep all remaining UI crates. Follows 26/11/17/FINISH-SHARED-BORDER-CONSOLIDATION-ACROSS-UI. Done = every UI Rust crate compiles its tests and passes, with a per-crate before/after table.
